title: Docs site builder renders the Anthus family footer with a configurable Contact us link
description: Biblicus docs (and every Papyrus docs_site build) must show the shared Anthus family footer with a Contact us link. Add --contact-url to docs_site so a site can point Contact us at its own engage URL; reuse family_footer; include footer CSS in the output.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged in AnthusAI/Papyrus#575 and released in papyrus-newsroom 5.27.0. Live on https://anthusai.github.io/Biblicus/ (Biblicus pins 5.31.0): every page shows the family footer with Contact us -> https://anth.us/engage/?solution=Biblicus&cta=docs, verified 2026-10-22. Follow-up for the owner: family_footer_stylesheet() copies only single-line CSS rules containing papyrus-family-footer, so a multi-line or media-query footer rule would be dropped silently; and config.py has a line-level comment on contact_url.
